files.scripts/brew-check.sh:
HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1
export HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE
tap=kogenai/tap
formula=kogenai/tap/kogen
tmp=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
mkdir $tmp/repo || exit 1
git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard | while IFS= read -r f; do
  mkdir -p $tmp/repo/$(dirname $f) && cp -p $f $tmp/repo/$f
done
(cd $tmp/repo && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=c -c user.email=c@localhost -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --no-verify -m c) || exit 1
brew list --formula >$tmp/before
failed=0
tapped=0
trusted=0
if brew tap $tap $tmp/repo; then
  tapped=1
  if brew trust --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    brew trust $tap && trusted=1 || failed=1
  fi
  if [ $failed = 0 ]; then
    brew style $formula && brew audit --strict $formula && brew install $formula && brew test $formula || failed=1
  fi
else
  failed=1
fi
brew list --formula >$tmp/after
new=$(grep -vxFf $tmp/before $tmp/after)
[ -z "$new" ] || brew uninstall $new || failed=1
if [ $trusted = 1 ]; then brew untrust $tap || failed=1; fi
if [ $tapped = 1 ]; then brew untap $tap || failed=1; fi
rm -rf $tmp
[ $failed = 0 ] || exit 1
echo 'brew-check: passed'
files.README.md:
# Kogen Homebrew tap

Homebrew tap for Kogen, which takes one requested feature through shaping, building, verifying and committing.

## Install

Homebrew 7 does not load formulae from third-party taps until the tap is trusted.

```
brew trust kogenai/tap && brew install kogenai/tap/kogen
```

## Update

```
brew upgrade kogen
```

A release updates the formula with `sh scripts/update-formula.sh`; `sh scripts/brew-check.sh` checks it against the real Homebrew.
